working_on.task: Hoàn thành Phase 1, 2, 3 của việc phân rã hook useChapterList thành các sub-hooks (UI, Dialogs) và presenter component lean.
working_on.notes: Codebase đã sạch hơn rất nhiều, tách biệt hoàn toàn logic UI và business. Type safety được đảm bảo 100% trong module này.

recent_changes.description: Raiden Intelligence Hub - A centralized command center for all AI discovery and dictionary management.
Monolithic ChapterList hook decomposition into useChapterListUI and useChapterListDialogs.
Presenter Component Cleanup - Extracted dialogs and selection dock to standalone components.
Strict Typing - Implementation of ChapterListState and ChapterListActions interfaces to replace 'any'.
Backup Service - Extracted JSON export logic to a dedicated service layer supporting Tauri and Browser.

decisions_made.reason: Maintaining state for UI (search, filters) and overlays in one file was becoming unmanageable and prone to dependency errors.

decisions_made.decision: Use of explicit Return Types for orchestration hooks
decisions_made.reason: Ensures that when we combine states and actions from multiple sub-hooks, the parent hook contract remains stable and well-documented.
